release_notes:
• Smooth Native Video Canvas Playback: Switched to hardware SurfaceView platform rendering to eliminate 15 FPS throttling and random frame stalls
• Zero-Freeze 10–15s HD YouTube Canvas Loops: Downloads bounded HD DASH clips and losslessly remuxes them locally via Android MediaExtractor + MediaMuxer
• Instant Per-Track Disk Cache: Reuses remuxed clips on repeat plays with zero network I/O
• Reduced Now Playing UI Overhead: Eliminated 4×/sec overlay rebuilds over the live video canvas
• Apple Music 1080p Canvas Preserved: Unchanged studio-grade playback
